teaser: A calculator left glowing on the counter past midnight is one trace of an 8 who is also an INTP. The 8 wants to build something that holds weight in the world — a company, a reputation, a number in an account that proves a theory correct. The INTP wants to know why the theory is true before anything gets built on top of it. Crossed, this makes a person who can spend years quietly testing a model of how power actually works, then execute it in a single decisive stretch, surprising everyone who assumed the thinking would never end.
excerpt: Three missed calls sit on the phone before you call back, voice even, as though nothing had been lost in the gap.
